title: Sync follower not working because "Disable all sync features" is somehow enabled
body:
**xDrip Version**
2021.08.18

**Problem**
There are reports that setting up xDrip+ Sync using QR code could result in "Disable all sync features" being enabled, which results in the follower not following.

**Suggested Solution**
Why do we need the checkbox Disable all sync features?  
The feature can be disabled on the master by disabling be master for followers, and on the follower by disabling collection.  
Can this checkbox be removed?
